Name: Better Grazing
Author: Tara864
Description:
[heading]About[/heading]
In Stardew Valley, farm animals often eat the grass closest to their barn or coop, leaving the area around the entrance completely bare while plenty of grass remains farther away.
I made this mod to change how animals choose where to graze. Instead of always eating nearby grass, they will also look for grass farther away from their buildings. This helps prevent the same area from being eaten repeatedly and gives the grass near the entrances more time to regrow.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip file into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/*]
[*]Windows, macOS, and Linux[/*]
[*]Multiplayer has not been fully tested.[/*]
[/list][heading]Notes[/heading]
This mod does not change grass growth speed. It only changes how animals choose grass to eat.

Manifest.Name: Better Grazing
Manifest.Description: Farm animals spread out to graze, with an optional maximum distance from their home door.
